# js-fileexplorer vendor files

Vendored from [cubiclesoft/js-fileexplorer](https://github.com/cubiclesoft/js-fileexplorer), revision
`b81b0ca131abd50243ca85054af070a35293e346`:

- `file-explorer.js`
- `file-explorer.css`
- `fileexplorer_actions.woff`
- `fileexplorer_sprites.png`

The upstream project offers MIT or LGPL licensing; this copy uses the MIT license in `LICENSE.txt`.
The application loads the widget only when a file browser is opened. Its upload, download, copy, cut, paste and
new file/folder tools are disabled. Only Delete is on, and only for the Library's imported files; uploads go
through the page's own button. Its data provider exposes directory listing, text reading and, for those
files, deleting.
